title: Part 1 : 2014: Guidelines for Integrated Planning, Development and Management of River Basins Part 1 Overall Planning
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 1) covers the guidelines for Integrated Planning, Development and Management of River Basins. Section | of the standard specifies the characteristics and resources of basin, present status of resources utilization and anticipated utilization.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
